'''Urcos Furdam''' was a [[human]] [[pilot]] of the [[Resistance]]. While of [[Alderaanian]] ancestry, Furdam was [[Reproduction|born]] after [[Alderaan]] was [[Destruction of Alderaan|destroyed]]. By [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROS Date" /> he was the co-pilot of the ''[[Tantive IV]]'', and regarded [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] as [[House of Organa|royalty]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Furdam [[Death|perished]] at<ref name="TROS EE Urcos" /> the [[Battle of Exegol]].<ref name="TROS Junior">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Urcos Furdam first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="Episode IX" /> and was identified by name in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on the same day as the film.<ref name="TROS VD" /> The character was portrayed by [[Marcus Mumford]], frontman of the band [[Wikipedia:Mumford & Sons|Mumford & Sons]], in a cameo performance.<ref name="FF">''[[Star Wars: Fascinating Facts]]''</ref>

Furdam's [[flight helmet]] was created within two days by [[Blaidon Props]], a model making company that also created all of the [[Resistance pilot]] [[helmet]]s for the film. The creators intended to build a conventional fighter pilot-style helmet connected to an oxygen mask. The helmet's visor was a repurposed [[stormtrooper]] lens prop from the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Furdam Helmet">{{Instagram|username=blaidonprops|url=p/CD1LfzPAKGU|name=[[Blaidon Props]]|date=2020-08-13|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/hCKSw}}</ref>
